title: Insanely lightweight
text: Insanely lightweight. This is advertised as heavyweight. I literally can’t use it because it’s so wispy and won’t stay put on my table. It is so beautiful. The linen in 💯 perfect. The needlework is so pretty. I love the color too. I just can’t use it unless it’s placed on a heavy table cloth and used as an additional layer.

product_metadata.title: Solino Home Linen Placemats Set of 4 – 100% Pure Linen Mulberry Tablemats 14 x 19 Inch – Heavyweight Hemstitch Placemats for Wedding, Living, Kitchen, Dining – Handcrafted from European Flax
features: Heavyweight Hemstitch Placemats Made of 100% Pure Handwoven European Linen Woven and Stonewashed for Exceptional Thickness and Natural Beauty. Edged With a Needlepoint Stitch That Creates a Delicate Border With an Heirloom Feel Perfectly Suited for Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter.

Easy Care -Machine Washable, Tumble Dry, Low Iron as Needed, Steam Iron for a crisp look. The beauty of each pure linen piece is the natural fibers and classic aesthetic that mellows with each washing, betters with age and requires minimal care.

Create a monochromatic or mix n’match look to fit your style with our coordinating products from this collection. Available in colors , sizes and styles for celebrating weddings, bridal showers, baby showers and special occasions, entertaining for Valentine’s Day, St. Patrick’s Day, Easter, Passover, Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Hanukkah, Christmas and or any holiday celebrations.

Like all fine linens and textiles, each batch of our linen is different and unique. The slight color and texture variations are an inherent quality of handcrafted pieces, adding to their beauty and bringing a wonderful heirloom feel to each piece.
